name: e4_core_ac1
question: The core's setups on the first autocorrelation inequality (minimise C; at most 30,000 steps), where the published LLM systems spread from 1.5100 (best of 25,600) to 1.5029 (TTT-Discover).

notes.floor: the model sees the best program and writes a better one, 6 times a round
notes.population: mutations from parents sampled by rank, with another strong program for ideas
notes.plan+notes: a planner with notes, plus mutations
notes.planned-only: the planner with notes, no mutations
